entries.name: Teeming Spitter

counterPressure.note: The earth-burn on hit only rewards a target already carrying a status — the spitter finishes rot it did not start, so it does nothing extra against a clean target.

entries.flavor: What it spits was rot an hour ago. Give it a season and it will be soil, then bloom, then rot again.

entries.name: Sodden Raincoat

counterPressure.note: A cultivated rung draws two to three affixes; this coat offers one raw-stat line (fortitude) plus a low mending trickle, landing well under the 60% raw-stat ceiling against that baseline.

entries.flavor: It never dries. Nothing under it does either, and that is exactly the point.

entries.name: Shroud of Decay

counterPressure.note: The ward layer only forms once the wearer is already dying — a shroud that will not close over anything still standing.

entries.flavor: Wrap the wound before the rot decides what grows there instead.

entries.name: Putrid Choker

counterPressure.note: Everything it pulls in it takes a small cut of first — the wearer's own baseline vitality is what feeds the exchange.

entries.flavor: Worn tight enough to smell everything it has already started to become.

entries.name: Sepal of Silage

counterPressure.note: Its raw-stat contribution is a single low ferocity line; the economy payoff is a capability, not a stat, so the item stays well under the raw-stat ceiling for its rung.

entries.notes: atom.midas is not in sense's own implicit slate (classes.v1.json lists that slate as a stopgap of atom.might/atom.ferocity only, because sense's named families — accuracy, crit rate — are stat.derived and quarantined). A unique's fixed core sits outside the drawn pool, where the role's affix-pool-tag filter never runs, so the break costs the schema nothing: the sense role stays exactly as unrollable for midas as before, and this one item is a deliberate exception, not a hole.
entries.flavor: It does not flower for bees. It flowers for what the compost pays back.

entries.name: Burgeoning Gumboot

counterPressure.note: The kick only lands from the front row — a boot with nothing to plant itself against does not swing any harder.

entries.notes: atom.might is not in footing's own implicit slate (classes.v1.json's stopgap there is atom.regeneration/atom.vitality only, since the role's named humanoid identity — evasion, movement, initiative — has no bindable family today). Fixed on a unique's core rather than drawn from the role's pool, so footing's rolled pool stays exactly as offense-free as it was.
entries.flavor: Something took root in the sole. It has not slowed the kicking any.

entries.name: Mouldreign

counterPressure.note: The wound knits shut the same way rot spreads — the mending is real, but it costs the gland's own baseline vitality to run.

entries.notes: atom.mending is a survivability family, not one of infusion's own legal families (classes.v1.json's infusion slate is the status.apply cluster — buttering, freezing, rotting, and the rest). Placed in the unique's fixed core rather than the drawn pool, so infusion's rolled affixes stay exactly the status-only set they were; atom.rotting is drawn from infusion's real slate and doubles as the theme's own name.
entries.flavor: The wound closes the way a fallen log closes over — slowly, and with something living in the seam.

entries.name: Rattle of the Windrow

counterPressure.note: Its only raw-stat presence is the low gardener spawn line; the grave-cell control it grants is a board capability, not a stat, so it lands comfortably under the rung's raw-stat ceiling.

entries.flavor: Shake it once at the turned earth. Whatever answers was already listening.
